title: The Seven Seals

questions.question: Now I watched when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say with a voice like thunder, "____!"
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:1 (ESV): "Now I watched when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say with a voice like thunder, 'Come!'"

questions.question: And I looked, and behold, a ____ horse! And its rider had a bow, and a crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:2 (ESV): "And I looked, and behold, a white horse! And its rider had a bow, and a crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer."

questions.question: When he opened the second seal... out came another horse, bright ____. Its rider was permitted to take peace from the earth, so that people should slay one another, and he was given a great sword.
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:3-4 (ESV): "When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, 'Come!' And out came another horse, bright red. Its rider was permitted to take peace from the earth, so that people should slay one another, and he was given a great sword."

questions.question: The rider of the red horse was permitted to take ____ from the earth, so that people should slay one another...
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:4 (ESV): "And out came another horse, bright red. Its rider was permitted to take peace from the earth, so that people should slay one another, and he was given a great sword."

questions.question: When he opened the third seal... I looked, and behold, a ____ horse! And its rider had a pair of scales in his hand.
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:5 (ESV): "When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, 'Come!' And I looked, and behold, a black horse! And its rider had a pair of scales in his hand."

questions.question: And I heard what seemed to be a voice... saying, "A quart of ____ for a denarius, and three quarts of ____ for a denarius, and do not harm the oil and wine!"
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:6 (ESV): "And I heard what seemed to be a voice in the midst of the four living creatures, saying, 'A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius, and do not harm the oil and wine!'"

questions.question: When he opened the fourth seal... I looked, and behold, a ____ horse! And its rider's name was Death, and Hades followed him.
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:7-8 (ESV): "When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, 'Come!' And I looked, and behold, a pale horse! And its rider's name was Death, and Hades followed him."

questions.question: And they were given authority over a ____ of the earth, to kill with sword and with famine and with pestilence and by wild beasts of the earth.
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:8 (ESV): "And they were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill with sword and with famine and with pestilence and by wild beasts of the earth."

questions.question: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the ____ the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the witness they had borne.
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:9 (ESV): "When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the witness they had borne."

questions.question: They cried out with a loud voice, "O Sovereign Lord, holy and true, how long before you will judge and avenge our blood on those who ____ on the earth?"
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:10 (ESV): "They cried out with a loud voice, 'O Sovereign Lord, holy and true, how long before you will judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?'"

questions.question: Then they were each given a white robe and told to ____ a little longer, until the number of their fellow servants and their brothers should be complete...
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:11 (ESV): "Then they were each given a white robe and told to rest a little longer, until the number of their fellow servants and their brothers should be complete, who were to be killed as they themselves had been."

questions.question: When he opened the sixth seal, I looked, and behold, there was a great ____, and the sun became black as sackcloth, the full moon became like blood,
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:12 (ESV): "When he opened the sixth seal, I looked, and behold, there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black as sackcloth, the full moon became like blood,"

questions.question: and the stars of the sky fell to the earth as the ____ tree sheds its winter fruit when shaken by a gale.
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:13 (ESV): "and the stars of the sky fell to the earth as the fig tree sheds its winter fruit when shaken by a gale."

questions.question: The sky vanished like a scroll that is being rolled up, and every ____ and ____ was removed from its place.
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:14 (ESV): "The sky vanished like a scroll that is being rolled up, and every mountain and island was removed from its place."

questions.question: calling to the mountains and rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of him who is seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the ____,"
questions.explanation: Revelation 6:16 (ESV): "calling to the mountains and rocks, 'Fall on us and hide us from the face of him who is seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,'"

key_verse_text: calling to the mountains and rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of him who is seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,"
